column1: # SpellAreaOverride.csv: put it beside the client executable (the name can be changed with [SpellArea] OverrideFile).
# Fixes or adds the area of a spell the spell data cannot describe. Read again when saved. See SpellArea.md.
# SpellId  : the spell's id (the number in its wowhead link)
# Shape    : circle | cone | line | none   (none = never draw this spell)
# Anchor   : caster | dest                  (circles only; cones and lines start at the caster)
# Radius   : circle radius / cone radius / line length
# Param    : cone angle in degrees / line width in yards
